_setup: Shared setup for every piece: g_everquest/display/eqmain/pc/players/sound manager/world connection point at objects; the old-UI windows (0x006018C0 0x00604984 0x006E4E58 0x006E4E5C 0x006E4E60 0x006E4E20 0x006E4DF4) and eqmain share wnd_vtbl (slot 1 +4 open, slot 2 +8 close, slot 4 +0x10 Show(int); open flag at window+0x10, zero = closed). is_3dON returns 0 here: a case overrides 0x00408e7f with ret 1 to reach the zone switch. operator_new returns 0: a case returns @newbuf and the ctor stub returns the same pointer.
_cases: P05: names compare against g_local_player->name (player+1, empty: player is zero-filled), so data[0]=0 matches and 'A' does not; zones compare against pc+0x974 (empty). 0x205B/0x20C5 set the float constants they compare against (0x0053510C 0x00535190 0x00535690 0x005351D4 0x005351F4) so both branch sides are known.
